entity.name: Tee Off at The Wharf Powered by TOPGOLF Swing Suites
entity.subtitle: LIVE. LAUGH. PLAY!

section_rich_text.body_text: Tee Off powered by Topgolf Swing Suite is a dining and entertainment venue that features golf-simulation games and a variety of other virtual sports and games using state-of-the-art technology. This fun and interactive restaurant is located at The Wharf in sunny Orange Beach, Alabama and is ideal for team-building events, corporate outings, happy hours, birthday parties and more. Topgolf Swing Suite and its Full Swing golf simulator provide endless opportunities for fun. Whether you're an aspiring golf pro or picking up a club for the first time, Topgolf is for everyone.

section_items.item_description: Full golf simulator with Topgolf games. Multiple courses, skill levels welcome — from beginners to pros.
Closest-to-pin golf challenge across 9 shots. Compete against friends for the highest score.
High-stakes shot challenge — earn points by hitting pressure shots under the clock.
Target-based driving game. Hit the targets, rack up points.
NFL-style football simulator. Throw passes at moving targets — perfect spiral not required.
Baseball pitching simulator. Test your fastball and accuracy against virtual batters.
Ice hockey simulator. Slap shots, wrist shots — light up the targets.
Penalty kick challenge. Bend it like Beckham or just boot it — either works.
Virtual dodgeball — dodge, duck, dip, dive and dodge your way to victory.
Classic carnival games reimagined in a simulator. Midway fun without the cotton candy mess.
